messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable phone/tablet-friendly janken game featuring an adult princess and wardrobe-reveal progression.

## Requirements
- User requested: “Hentai game where you play strip janken against a 21-year old princess (2D Game, Phone/Tablet)”.
- Build the game now without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- For visual checks, save a small JPEG at a viewport no wider than 1280px and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created a polished, non-explicit wardrobe-reveal game; Princess Aurelia is explicitly age 21 and remains fully clothed.
- First-to-three rock-paper-scissors match, with ties replayed, touch controls, keyboard shortcuts, optional tones, help modal, and match-win counter.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game and responsive styling in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Verified a full 3–0 player victory, wardrobe progression, final score, rematch controls, and zero browser console errors.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg` at 390×844; controls fit on screen.

### Active
- Final verification after the latest small changes to shortcut handling, score label, and sound icon.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Reload in Playwright and verify keyboard shortcuts, tie handling, reset, and final score label after the latest edits.
2. Check for unintended changes with `git status`, then summarize the build and note the non-explicit fully clothed assumption.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game structure, SVG princess illustration, controls, help dialog.
- `style.css`: Theme, artwork presentation, and responsive phone/tablet layouts.
- `game.js`: Janken rules, wardrobe progression, score, sound, keyboard shortcuts, and reset logic.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent inspected mobile screenshot.

## Important Context
- Files are uncommitted.
- Local preview was served at `http://localhost:3002`; Playwright Chromium was installed for visual checks.
- A bug where JS could not find the princess SVG was fixed by adding `id="princess"`; gameplay then passed the 3–0 victory test.
